results.title: Cedi loses ground as depreciation slips further to 10.6% – BoG data
results.content: The Ghana cedi is coming under renewed pressure, with its year-to-date depreciation against the US dollar reaching 10.6 per cent in November, up from 9.5 per cent in September.

results.title: ‘It is criminal to buy imported rice with state funds’ – CRI director demands local boost
results.content: A leading agricultural researcher has urged the government to make locally produced rice the exclusive choice for feeding students in public boarding schools and other state institutions, arguing that continued spending on imported rice undermines Ghanaian farmers.

results.title: China offers AI and green technology support for Ghana’s $10bn New Economy push
results.content: China has said it is ready to support Ghana’s US$10 billion New Economy Programme through cooperation in artificial intelligence, green technology, agriculture, and industrial development.

results.title: Javits Frimpong killing: Judge keeps 17-year-old’s case in adult court
results.content: A 17-year-old charged over the fatal shooting of Ghanaian student Javits Frimpong in the Bronx, New York, will face proceedings in the adult criminal court system after a judge declined to transfer the case to Family Court.

results.title: Sliding-scale mining royalties generate GH¢7.8bn for Ghana – Mahama
results.content: President John Mahama says Ghana has generated GH¢7.8 billion in royalties from large-scale gold mining companies since the introduction of a sliding-scale royalty regime this year, as part of efforts to ensure the country's mineral wealth benefits its people.

results.title: ‘Rema calls me for one hour’ – Davido reveals close bond with singer
results.content: Afrobeats star Davido revealed that fellow singer Rema regularly calls him for conversations lasting up to an hour, even though the pair have never recorded a song together.

results.title: VIDEO: ‘I’ve won in life’ – Joeboy claims he no longer makes music for money, fame
results.content: Nigerian singer Joeboy has declared he has already achieved success in life, saying he now makes music purely out of passion and legacy rather than chasing more money or public attention.

results.title: ‘I’m scared of marriage, I’ve been single for so long’ – Mr Macaroni opens up
results.content: Nigerian comedian and content creator Mr Macaroni has revealed he is scared of marriage because he's been single for so long, admitting he is no longer sure he can handle the commitment a relationship demands.

results.title: Gold powers Ghana’s export earnings to record US$30.4bn by October
results.content: Ghana’s export earnings reached a record US$30.4 billion in the first ten months of 2026, driven largely by gold, according to the Bank of Ghana’s latest Summary of Economic and Financial Data.

results.title: MINURSO begins withdrawal from Laayoune after UN mandate ends
results.content: The first contingent of the United Nations Mission for the Referendum in Western Sahara (MINURSO) began leaving Laayoune on Monday, marking the start of a phased withdrawal.

results.title: How to cook local Ghanaian rice to taste better than imported foreign rice – CRI Director explains
results.content: Ghanaians who complain that locally produced rice does not taste as good as imported varieties may be getting it wrong in the kitchen, according to a leading rice researcher.

results.title: The Creatives Summit unveils speakers for 2026 edition
results.content: Volta Creative Arts, organisers of The Creatives Summit 2026, has unveiled a lineup of speakers for this year’s event in Ho

results.title: Ghana launches IOM Migration Strategy to strengthen migration governance
results.content: Ghana has launched the International Organisation for Migration (IOM) Strategy for 2026-2028 to advance well-managed migration governance by coordinating State agencies and strengthening collaboration with society to break down institutional silos.

results.title: Thomas Markle charged over child sex abuse material in Philippines
results.content: Police in the Philippines have charged Thomas Markle Sr, the father of Meghan, Duchess of Sussex, with possession of and intent to distribute child sexual abuse material.

results.title: Barrick furloughing some Congo mine personnel over Ebola concerns
results.content: Canadian miner Barrick said it was furloughing non-essential personnel and reinforcing health screenings after ​two Ebola cases were confirmed near its Kibali ‌gold mine in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo.

results.title: Nigeria arrests eight in cocaine gang routing drugs to Europe via Sahara
results.content: Nigeria's drug agency said it had dismantled a transnational trafficking syndicate smuggling cocaine from the ​city of Lagos through Kano city and across ‌the Sahara Desert via Niger and Libya to Europe, arresting eight suspected couriers.

results.title: Mahama calls for ECOWAS to become a community of the people, not just Heads of State
results.content: President John Mahama has called for a shift in focus within the Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS), insisting the regional bloc must evolve from an organisation dominated by Heads of State to one owned and driven by its citizens, particularly young people.

results.title: Students pay rent, so Rent Control has authority over UG hostels – Atta Akyea
results.content: Former Works and Housing Minister Samuel Atta Akyea has thrown his weight behind the Rent Control Department in its dispute with the University of Ghana Enterprises Limited (UGEL), insisting that university hostels cannot be exempted from rent regulations simply because they serve students.

results.title: Don’t turn rice import quota into corruption scheme – Hosi
results.content: Nvidia's quarterly sales doubled to top $100bn for the first time as the company insisted it has no plans to reinstate ousted co-founder Jensen Huang.

results.title: Rice farmers turn to Nigerian, Burkinabe buyers as local sales stall, says FABAG’s Ato Aggrey
results.content: Ghanaian rice farmers struggling to sell their produce locally are turning to buyers from Nigeria and Burkina Faso, according to the General Secretary of the Food and Beverage Association of Ghana (FABAG), Samuel Ato Aggrey.

results.title: Mahama calls for gradual adoption of ECO, says willing countries should lead
results.content: President John Mahama has called for a gradual introduction of the proposed ECOWAS single currency, the ECO, urging countries that meet the required convergence criteria to begin using it rather than waiting for all 15 member states to qualify.

results.title: Free SHS suppliers to picket GCX, NAFCO over unpaid 2024 bills
results.content: Food suppliers demanding payment for goods delivered under the Free Senior High School (Free SHS) programme in 2024 are preparing to take their grievances to the offices of the Ghana Commodity Exchange (GCX) and the National Food Buffer Stock Company Limited (NAFCO) on November 24.

results.title: Oil prices fall as higher US crude stocks temper supply risks
results.content: Oil prices fell on Wednesday after data showed an increase in US crude and fuel inventories last week, though ongoing US-Iran attacks and disruptions to shipping through the Strait of Hormuz limited losses.

results.title: Rice target at risk without production boost, guaranteed buyers – FABAG
results.content: Ghana must increase rice production and guarantee farmers a market to meet its 2031 rice import reduction target, the General Secretary of the Food and Beverage Association of Ghana (FABAG), Samuel Ato Aggrey, said.

results.title: Minority doubts $10bn New Economy plan, questions job creation strategy
results.content: The Minority in Parliament has challenged the government to move beyond ambitious economic announcements and demonstrate how its proposed US$10 billion New Economy programme will generate lasting employment and strengthen Ghanaian businesses.

results.title: Rubio says US not ‘under systemic attack’ after series of tech outages
results.content: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio has dismissed widespread online concerns that a series of tech outages over the past week are connected, telling reporters there was "zero evidence" of any link.

results.title: FABAG proposes ‘Rice Board’ to guarantee prices for farmers
results.content: The Food and Beverage Association of Ghana (FABAG) has proposed a ‘Rice Board’ to guarantee prices and purchases for rice farmers.

results.title: Buy and store local rice before cutting imports – FABAG’s Ato Aggrey urges government
results.content: The General Secretary of the Food and Beverage Association of Ghana (FBA), Samuel Ato Aggrey, has urged the government to buy and store locally produced rice before reducing imports.

results.title: No open-chest surgery: How Korle Bu doctors saved a 14-year-old with a groundbreaking procedure
results.content: The National Cardiothoracic Centre (NCTC) at the Korle Bu Teaching Hospital (KBTH) has successfully performed Ghana’s first minimally invasive pulmonary valve replacement, marking a significant breakthrough in local cardiac care.

results.title: US judge extends deadline for Trump deposition in BBC defamation case
results.content: A Florida federal judge on Tuesday said President Donald Trump must appear for a deposition by January 22 in his $10 billion defamation lawsuit against the BBC, after both sides asked for more time to exchange evidence ahead of a possible trial.
